name: TheTVDB
author: Chronicle Contributors
description: Metadata for TV series, seasons, and episodes from TheTVDB — the community standard used by Sonarr, Plex, Kodi, Trakt, and SIMKL.
fixMatchHint: Enter a TheTVDB series ID (76290), a series URL (https://thetvdb.com/series/breaking-bad), or for a specific episode use episode:{episodeId} (episode:308662). Series slugs in URLs are resolved automatically.

background_tasks.description: Fetches TheTVDB metadata for TV items that have a TVDB ID stored (from Trakt or SIMKL sync) but have not yet been enriched by TheTVDB.
Re-fetches all TheTVDB metadata to pick up community edits, new episodes, and artwork changes.

settings.label: TheTVDB API Key
settings.description: Your TheTVDB API key. Get one free at https://thetvdb.com/dashboard.

settings.label: Preferred Language
settings.description: ISO 639-2 three-letter language code (e.g. eng, fra, deu, jpn). Note: TVDB uses 3-letter codes unlike TMDB's 2-letter codes.

settings.label: Fallback Language
settings.description: Language used when no translation exists in the preferred language.
